correctness.rationale: Generator rank proves exactly the ±connected-indicator facet normals and full center inequality system. Exact induction gives the hypercube induced-edge bound; the scalar lower-envelope has strict endpoint minimizers, with sharp crossover between d=5 and 6. Active facet ranks and positive slack prove center dimensions. Degree bound and parity signs prove both unique outer contacts, R and diameter. The 77,255 independent exact bounded assertions succeeded, without substituting finite tests for an infinite proof.

value.rationale: A canonical cubical graph family in a newly introduced polytope construction has a complete Euclidean radius, tangency, center-locus and diametral classification. Adding coordinate generators moves the purely graphical-zonotope phase change to dimension six, collapses an exponential-dimensional center family, and creates an exponential jump from two to 2^(d+1) tangent facets. This motivates the precise invariant and is not a renamed edge-cut inequality or a single arbitrary numeric case.
